Background (from the session that started this one):
This is a throwaway session for DeepBuild issue #47's fixture corpus. The folder's .claude/settings.json records each hook payload so the Claude desktop app's resume prompt, sent after the app is quit mid-turn, can be recorded. The session must be in the middle of one long tool call when the app is quit and reopened. It must not edit files or run anything else.

Task:
Run exactly this one command with the Bash tool, in the foreground (not in the background), and wait for it to finish; it takes 30 minutes: node -e "setTimeout(() => console.log('done'), 1800000)"
Do nothing else before it ends. When it ends, or if you are told to continue after an interruption, reply with only the word resumed and stop. Do not use any other tool.

Shared notes folder for this group of sessions (outside the repo; read siblings' notes there, leave hand-over notes or large findings there instead of pasting them into messages): ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/side-session-notes/local_52f995a4-3806-4a10-acc6-9dfa71c9ae0b
